Sierra Space develops space and defense technologies, including satellites, spacecraft, and mission systems that support national security and space exploration. The Software Engineer I - Ground Software role designs, develops, and tests software applications for space systems, writes maintainable code, collaborates with senior engineers, manages code using version control, participates in code reviews, troubleshoots issues, and documents software processes.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and test software applications for space systems and technologies
Write clean, maintainable code that adheres to best practices and coding standards
Collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and complete assigned tasks efficiently
Utilize version control systems such as Git to manage code changes and work collaboratively with team members
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and compliance with development standards
Troubleshoot and resolve software-related issues in a timely manner
Document software designs, configurations, processes, and procedures for future reference
Stay current with industry trends and advancements in software development and space technologies to continuously improve your skills and contribute effectively to the team

Frontend development experience, preferably using React, Typescript, NodeJS, FastAPI or similar
Familiarity with both Windows and Linus/Unix development environments
Understanding of basic networking concepts (TCP/IP, sockets, client-server architectures)
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and/or automated testing frameworks
Exposure to command and control (C2), telemetry, or mission-operations software concepts
Basic understanding of spacecraft, satellite, or ground system operations concepts
Understanding of Agile software development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team environment
